target_customer: Hardware companies in robotics, aerospace and medical devices that need custom circuit boards
problem: Designing, fabricating and sourcing parts for a printed circuit board takes months and many iterations, slowing hardware startups.
business_model: Design services starting at $10,000 per design plus fabrication and assembly revenue, with a self serve AI design tool

founders.name: Davide Asnaghi
founders.background_notes: a16z's announcement lists Apple, Butterfly Network and Chromatic for the founding pair, without assigning each employer to one founder.

founders.name: Lenny Khazan
founders.background_notes: Employers are from the a16z announcement and are shared with the other founder.

competitors.name: Quilter
competitors.funding_then: $10M Series A led by Benchmark per its own timeline

competitors.name: Flux.ai
competitors.what: Browser based ECAD with AI features

technical_complexity.rationale: Producing manufacturable boards with AI plus fabrication, assembly and component supply chain handling combines hard software and physical operations.

defensibility.rationale: Reusable tested modules, a code first design compiler and supply chain handling are harder to copy than software alone, yet several funded AI PCB rivals exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: EDA incumbents did not acquire Diode as far as found, while Quilter and Flux kept raising. Diode raised its own Series A led by a16z in July 2025.

market_need_then: Hardware startups reported months long PCB cycles, and robotics and defense hardware demand grew in 2024 alongside AI code generation.

branding.domain_note: Uses diode.computer, not diode.com. Acquisition history not found.

identity.visual_style: Minimal product focused site with photos of its own boards and a normal versus X-ray image toggle
identity.voice_and_tone: Short and technical, with numbered Design, Fab, Assemble steps

branding.brand_signature: Showcased open source boards named Whisper and Helm plus a PCB X-ray toggle
branding.community_and_virality: Shares open source reference designs and handles @diodeinc on X and GitHub per the a16z post

brand_strength.rationale: Name fits electronics and is short, and its own boards act as marketing, but no press about the brand and confusion with Diodes Incorporated in searches.

outcome_analysis: Diode is a YC S24 company that went from a ten person team to an a16z led Series A of reported $11.4M in July 2025 by combining AI design with its own fabrication and assembly service. The investor cited technical founders with hardware and software range. It still competes with Quilter, Flux and JITX, and no exit has occurred.
notes: The a16z post confirms the Series A but does not state the amount. The $11.4M figure and co-investors come from trade press (PCB Directory, Technews180, VCBacked). A $500K seed in September 2024 and a $14.5M seed in May 2025 appear on single aggregators and are unverified. A $91M valuation on Caplight is an estimate and is not recorded. Total raised over $14 million is claimed by PCB Directory.
